hero.caption: Fields on the northwestern side of Kentucky Route 8 immediately east of Bentley Lane in South Portsmouth, Kentucky, United States.  Part of this field was the site of Lower Shawneetown; it is an archaeological site and listed on the National Register of Historic Places, and it forms part of a Register-listed historic district, the Lower Shawneetown Archeological District.
